title: sceptridium tenuifolium
intro: Sceptridium tenuifolium, commonly known as Chinese king fern, is a plant species in the lily family (Liliaceae). It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Chinese king fern include reducing fever, relieving pain and swelling, and promoting blood circulation. The bioactive constituents of Chinese king fern include polysaccharides, flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
